title: A 40-A/Channel Compensated 18-Channel Strain Gauge Measurement System for Stress Monitoring in Dental Implants
figure_number: Fig. 1. Schematic of a dental prosthesis bridge, supported by abutments and implants.
function_summary: analog-to-digital converter (ADC): The total chip consumes a mere 40 A/channel (at 3.1 V) and allows for sampling of each individual strain gauge channel at a sampling rate of 111 Hz with a 20strain accuracy.
